scene: The crawler rattles along its cable toward the churning bridge gears.
beats: You crisp up her creased blueprint, uncovering a secret shortcut to the bridge's noodle stalls just as the crawler docks and clanks its doors open.
You give the tiny key a twist. The brass bird trills a jaunty tune, signaling the conductor to slide the exit doors wide open.
He shares clever tricks for dodging turning gears, handing you a wrench ticket as the brakes hiss and the platform doors rumble open.
picture: Inside the rattling brass tram car, a level row of rivets runs along the floor. On the far left sits a woman with a large paper map. In the centre, the player stands beside a caged clockwork bird. To the right, a tea-drinking mechanic sits by large floor levers. Outside the rectangular windows, glowing neon signs recede.
shown: a woman struggling with an origami map on the bench to the left
a brass birdcage holding a ticking mechanical finch at the centre
a boiler-suited mechanic sipping tea beside heavy lever controls on the far right

after.label: Stay on
after.beat: You stay put as Gear Bridge fades behind. After a brisk transfer at the terminal, the night funicular hoists you up toward Comet Watch Rooftop, brimming with cocoa robots and deckchairs.
after.then: Step off at Comet Watch Rooftop

variants.scene: The cable car hums as neon city lights glide past the misty windows.

A quick turn of the key makes the metal bird chirp a cheerful melody, prompting the conductor to pull the doors open wide.
The mechanic explains how to safely bypass huge spinning cogs and gives you a wrench ticket while the brakes hiss and doors rumble open.
variants.ride_on: You remain aboard as Gear Bridge disappears. Following a quick change at the terminal, the night funicular carries you up to Comet Watch Rooftop, packed with cocoa robots and deckchairs.

You wind the toy bird until it whistles a merry jingle, and the conductor responds by parting the entrance doors right away.
He gives you handy advice on slipping past moving machine parts, passing you a brass wrench ticket as the cabin thumps and doors glide open.

variants.scene: The carriage rattles steadily across the skyline above glowing streets.
beats: You press the map flat, pinpointing a clever back route to the bridge's noodle stands as the car stops and its doors swing open.
Twisting the tiny key sets the brass bird singing a lively song, cueing the conductor to shove the side doors open.
He shares useful tips for dodging giant clockwork teeth, handing over a stamped wrench ticket just as the brakes squeal and doors roll open.
variants.ride_on: You sit tight while Gear Bridge shrinks away. After switching lines at the bustling terminal, the night funicular lifts you toward Comet Watch Rooftop, full of friendly cocoa robots and deckchairs.
